extraction.notes: No qualifying supervised youth summer camp was found. The Summer Day Pass requires all participants under 18 to have active supervision from a chaperone or guardian throughout every activity. The all-inclusive getaway page announces 2027 dates and says "Summer Family Camp: Dates Coming Soon!", but this is a family getaway rather than a youth camp.
